bio.text: Toni Edmonds Walker is a Connecticut state representative for New Haven and House Chair of the Appropriations Committee; she is also a member of the Judiciary Committee and a former House chair of the Human Services Committee.
She has lived in New Haven for most of her life and was previously director of the Dixwell Children's Creative Arts Center.
She studied at Southern Connecticut State University and received a Master's degree in Social Work from Fordham University.
Outside the legislature she is Vice Principal and Coordinator of Special Services and Grants at New Haven Adult Education.
